strategy_note: Carries on from the rival's own GW11 squad. Elite 3-4-3: safe-haven core (Haaland, De Cuyper, Groß, Raya) plus calculated differentials (Rudoni, Vuskovic). Built blind from data/cache/xpts.json (GW12). No access to the user's squad. data/features.json is a stale GW1 pre-season snapshot, so it was not used for current form or ownership. player_pool.json is empty this week and was ignored.

transfers.reason: Gibbs-White has collapsed to 1.89 xPts (NFO, FDR 4). Wirtz has the best MID xPts in the pool (9.53, LIV, FDR 3). Gain of +7.64 in the XI. Selling Gibbs-White rather than Gakpo frees 0.4m more (7.8 vs 7.1), and both are dead money. LIV count goes to 2 (Wirtz, Gakpo).

transfer_note: 1 FT assumed because all banked FTs were used in GW11 (5 FT + 1 hit). No hit this week. The best second move (Gakpo -> E.Le Fée, 7.48) would only replace Groß (5.57) in the XI, a gain of +1.91, which is below the -4 cost. Gakpo (0.42) stays as bench fodder and is the next FT target.
chip_note: No chip. No BGW (all XI have fixtures), no confirmed DGW, and fewer than 3 starters are rotation-flagged. Save WC/TC/BB/FH under the APEX chip-timing gates.

budget.note: Estimate: GW11 ITB of 3.2 plus 0.4 from Gibbs-White (7.8) -> Wirtz (7.4). The real figure depends on the purchase price of Gibbs-White, because FPL keeps only half of any rise on sale.
budget.cap_check: Max 3 per club holds: BHA 3 (De Cuyper/Vuskovic/Groß), ARS 2 (Raya/Konsa), BOU 2 (Tavernier/Evanilson), LIV 2 (Wirtz/Gakpo), all others 1.

key_differential: Rudoni (COV, about 1.2% TSB at GW11, 5.0m, 7.37 xPts, FDR 3). Secondary: Vuskovic (BHA, about 8.6% TSB at GW11, 8.28 xPts). Ownership figures carry over from GW11 because features.json is stale.
risks: Captain Haaland follows the locked APEX cum_pts rule (season leader among nailed outfield premiums, about 70 pts at GW11). He is at FDR 5 with only 4.48 xPts, while Evanilson (9.41) and N.Jackson (9.11) each project about +4.9 more as captain. The armband shields against a very highly owned Haaland, not a play for rank. This is the biggest variance point this GW.
The locked 3-4-3 starts Haaland (4.48) over De Cuyper (7.23). A 4-4-2 with Haaland benched would add about +2.75 base points, but that breaks both the strategy shape and the captain rule.
Tzolakis (7.41, HUL FDR 2) starts in goal over Raya (4.10, ARS FDR 4).
BHA triple-up (De Cuyper/Vuskovic/Groß) all at FDR 3. Correlated clean-sheet risk.
Maitland-Niles is not in the xpts.json pool and fails the rotation gate, so he is the 3rd bench sub.
